title: Android ViewSwitcher: delayed animation
purpose: Check that an Android XML animation set waits for its startOffset before transitioning between views.
changes: The XML importer and renderer now honor startOffset on alpha and translate animations and their enclosing sets. This example uses an 800 ms delay, then a 500 ms slide and fade.
steps: Press Show next view and watch the colored view.
The first view should remain in place briefly. After about 0.8 seconds it slides and fades away while the second view slides and fades in.
Press the button again and check the same delay before the view changes back. Choose OK if it behaves as described, or Reject with details and your device.
expected: The view stays visible during the delay, then the two views transition smoothly; both directions work.
limits: The example demonstrates one set-level delay. Android device timing and visual parity have not been verified; other animation types and ObjectAnimator start delays remain unsupported.

references.scope: Animation-set start offsets and child offsets.

validation: 154 XML importer tests and 196 Android XML Rust tests passed, including nested and independent start offsets.
A 320 × 440 browser test checks the view before and after the delay.
